verdict.rationale: Granola documents a few of its own event-driven automations. Notes added to folders can be set to sync automatically to HubSpot records. Follow-up emails are auto-drafted after external meetings. A Zapier integration lets users automate what happens after a meeting. However, there is no native, general-purpose rules engine for defining custom event→action triggers, and arbitrary rule logic would live in Zapier rather than Granola. Missing for 10: a native user-defined rule/trigger builder, documented event types and conditions, webhooks or event subscriptions, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.
